title: Pay Visibility Is Increasing

Statement_01.text: We are confident in our pay practices.

Statement_02.text: Timing and details may differ from country to country.

Callout_01.text: U.S. & Europe: Brunswick includes pay ranges on all job postings as a consistent, company-wide practice.

Callout_02.text: The EU Pay Transparency Directive has introduced new pay transparency requirements across EU countries.

Impact_01.text: Your local HR team will share more information about any changes relevant to your location.

narration.text: Around the world, compensation practices are becoming more visible — and Brunswick supports that direction, because we are confident in our pay practices. In the U.S. and Europe, Brunswick includes pay ranges on all job postings as a consistent, company-wide practice. If you work in Europe, the EU Pay Transparency Directive took effect in June 2026. At a high level, it gives employees the right to request information about their pay, average pay levels for comparable roles broken down by gender, and the criteria used for pay progression. Your local HR team will share specifics as the requirements take effect in your country.
